system_description.narrative_title: Rates, inflation and bond-market stress amid policy uncertainty
system_description.narrative_summary: News coverage is dominated by a global story of persistent inflation and central banks wrestling with whether to pause or raise interest rates, producing volatility in sovereign and corporate bond markets. Monetary-policy decisions, fiscal moves (notably the UK budget), economic data and political shocks interact through expectations and capital flows, creating feedbacks that transmit into mortgage costs, government borrowing costs and asset prices.
system_description.scope: Central bank policy decisions and guidance (Fed, ECB, BoC, RBA, RBNZ, BOJ), sovereign and corporate bond yields, inflation data and expectations, fiscal policy actions (UK Budget), market reactions across FX, equities, gold and mortgages, and the transmission to households, banks and corporate credit.
system_description.super_system: Global macro-financial system (international monetary policy, capital markets and cross-border capital flows)
adjacent_subsystems: Government fiscal policy and sovereign debt market
Commodity and inflation drivers (energy, food, supply chains)

variables.name: Policy interest rate level
variables.description: The prevailing short-term official policy interest rate set by monetary authorities.

variables.name: Policy rate expectations
variables.description: Market and agent expectations about the future path and terminal level of policy interest rates.

variables.name: Policy uncertainty
variables.description: The degree of ambiguity and unpredictability surrounding future monetary and fiscal policy decisions.

variables.name: Consumer price inflation
variables.description: The rate of change in a broad consumer price index measuring the general rise in consumer prices.

variables.name: Inflation expectations
variables.description: Medium- to long-run expected rate of inflation embedded in surveys, markets and contracts.

variables.name: Sovereign bond yield level
variables.description: The market yield (interest rate) on government debt across benchmark maturities.

variables.name: Corporate bond spread level
variables.description: The average premium that corporate debt yields command over comparable-maturity sovereign yields.

variables.name: Bond market liquidity
variables.description: The ease and cost at which participants can buy or sell sovereign and corporate bonds without large price impact.

variables.name: Cross-border capital flows
variables.description: Net financial flows moving between jurisdictions, including portfolio, bank and direct investment flows.

variables.name: Fiscal balance position
variables.description: The ongoing budgetary stance measured by the government deficit or surplus relative to economic output.

variables.name: Government borrowing need
variables.description: The flow of net debt issuance required to finance the fiscal deficit and maturing liabilities.

variables.name: Mortgage interest rate level
variables.description: The prevailing interest rates charged on household mortgage lending across typical maturities and products.

variables.name: Household real disposable income
variables.description: After-tax household income adjusted for inflation, determining real purchasing power for consumption and saving.

variables.name: Bank lending conditions
variables.description: The supply and terms of bank credit including spreads, covenants and willingness to lend to households and firms.

variables.name: Financial market volatility
variables.description: The magnitude and frequency of price swings across financial asset classes, especially bonds and equities.

variables.name: Exchange rate level
variables.description: The market value of a currency relative to other currencies, affecting trade and capital flow valuations.

catalysts.title: ECB flagged December rate hike
catalysts.description: ECB has signalled a likely rate increase in December, making a December hike a near-term market-moving event.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'ECB flags December hike' and 'ECB keeps rates unchanged but points to mounting inflation risk'.

catalysts.title: Fed's 'information-rich' period and near-term decisions
catalysts.description: The Fed signalled a pause but warned an 'information-rich' period is coming, implying incoming data will drive near-term policy moves and expectations.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Warsh says an ‘information-rich’ period is coming', 'Fed leaves rates unchanged'.

catalysts.title: Persistent elevated global inflation into next year
catalysts.description: Surveys and recent PCE data point to inflation remaining high into next year, sustaining policy pressure and market repricing.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'High inflation to persist globally into next year, Reuters poll shows' and 'PCE Inflation Accelerated Last Month'.

catalysts.title: UK gilt market repricing after Healey's Budget
catalysts.description: Markets remain sensitive to UK fiscal choices; further gilt volatility or repricing could strain borrowing costs and buffers.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Healey’s £15BN Buffer Could Vanish With One Gilt Market Lurch', 'U.K. Budget Ducks Hard Choices Amid Market Concerns Over Debt'.

catalysts.title: Brazil fiscal reckoning and market fallout after Lula win
catalysts.description: Lula's surprise re-election and market rout create a near-term process of fiscal choices, market reaction and currency pressure.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Lula Wins Fourth Term', 'Brazilian Markets Crash After Lula’s Surprise Election Win', 'Brazil's currency plunges most since 1999'.

catalysts.title: Potential additional Bank of Canada rate hike
catalysts.description: BoC has raised rates and signalled another hike is possible, making further increases a near-term catalyst for Canadian rates and mortgages.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Bank of Canada raises key interest rate, says another hike possible', 'Bank of Canada poised to hike...'.

catalysts.title: RBA debate on additional hikes
catalysts.description: RBA officials warn inflation remains high and debate more hikes, creating a process that could lift Australian policy rates and yields.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'RBA Governor Bullock warns that inflation remains high, to debate more rate hikes', 'RBA’s Blunt Messaging Raises Questions About Peak in Rates'.

catalysts.title: Changes to FOMC meeting format and communications
catalysts.description: FOMC procedural changes announced by Kevin Warsh will alter meeting cadence/communication, affecting how markets form expectations and react.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Fed's Warsh announces changes in how future FOMC meetings will go', 'Kevin Warsh Wanted the Fed to Be Quiet. Instead, It’s as Noisy as Ever.'

catalysts.title: AI-driven portfolio rebalancing and bond market volatility
catalysts.description: Reports warn of an 'AI unwind' that could trigger rapid reallocation from bonds to equities (or vice versa), creating bond-market volatility and liquidity stress.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Global Bond Markets May Face More Volatility Amid an AI Unwind', 'Equities and bond yields dip with AI jitters'.

catalysts.title: Next US monthly PCE inflation release
catalysts.description: The forthcoming monthly PCE release will be a key data point for the Fed and markets, likely to move expectations and bond yields.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'PCE Inflation Accelerated Last Month' and multiple notes that Fed awaits further data.
